items.title: I’m 64 with two sons, but only one works in the family firm. Should I leave him 70% of the business?
items.description: “I have some reservations about the long-term stability of my younger son’s marriage.”

items.title: Retiring abroad? Don’t cut these financial ties to the U.S.
items.description: Think carefully about your Social Security, Medicare, credit cards and bank accounts before picking your new home overseas.

items.title: ‘It’s a wait-and-see situation’: I’m 63 and diagnosed with lymphoma. Should I take my Social Security next year?
items.description: “My plan is to continue working as long as I’m able to do so and invest my Social Security benefits while I’m still earning a paycheck.”

items.title: Is Apple’s foldable iPhone Duo worth $2,000? See how it stacks up against other foldable phones.
items.description: Preorders for the iPhone Duo began Friday, marking Apple’s debut in a foldable phone market largely dominated by Samsung and Google.

items.title: The stock market has already crashed: Why a Wall Street veteran says Nike is the ultimate turnaround trade.
items.description: Larry McDonald says the S&P 500’s record chasing is hiding lots of companies with sliding stocks. He has ideas on how to play that.

items.description: Even though October’s correction has brought about some relief for bond markets and revivified the rate sensitive sectors of the stock market, Bank of America’s strategists recommend staying risk-off

items.title: Influencers and biohackers swear by fasting. Here’s what the science says.
items.description: Fasting can help some people reduce how many calories they eat — but it’s not “effortless” as some influencers would have you believe.

items.title: My wife says we can’t afford to retire. I vetoed her $8,000 trip to Italy. We’re in our 60s and have $4 million. Do I keep working?
items.description: “I worry about healthcare, long-term care, inflation, a long bear market and living to 95.”

items.title: Can a $55,000-plus robot load the dishwasher? Inside my afternoon with two humanoid housekeepers.

items.title: Nearly 40% of the S&P 500 is in a bear market. Here are 10 of those stocks that analysts say can gain up to 81%.
items.description: The S&P 500’s strong overall performance reflects its heavy weighting at the top. Under the surface, nearly 40% of the index’s stocks are down at least 20% from their 52-week highs.
